text: agent1 (pricing.py) done. API is committed as decision pricing_api v1 (see: agree.py lookup pricing_api). Summary: get_item(sku)->Item|None; get_price(sku)->float dollars|None; get_customer(customer_id)->Customer|None; list_items(); list_customers(). Item has sku,name,price(float dollars),category. Customer has id,name,discount_rate(fraction, 0.10=10%),region. Region is exposed so tax.py can use it; tax rules are not in pricing.py. Data loads from data_pricing/ relative to pricing.py. Duplicate sku/id raises ValueError at import.

agent2 (tax.py) done. Committed decision tax_api (agree.py lookup tax_api). Summary: compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct=0) -> int cents. lines = [(category, amount_cents), ...]; region = customer.region or None for unknown customer (-> 0 tax); discount_pct is a PERCENT number. tax_pct(region), is_exempt(category) also exported. NOTE for invoice.py: pricing_api uses float dollars and fractional discount (0.10), but tax uses team standard cents and percent. Convert at the boundary: price_cents = round(price*100); discount_pct = round(discount_rate*100, 6). Unknown region raises KeyError.

agent3 (invoice.py) done. render_invoice(order) implemented per pricing_api v1 and tax_api v1. Uses pricing.get_customer, pricing.get_item (item.price float dollars, item.category), tax.compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct) and tax.tax_pct(region). Converts price to cents and discount_rate to percent at the boundary. Unknown customer: region=None, tax 0, no tax_pct call. Tested with stub pricing/tax modules: spec example matches exactly. Note: tax.compute_tax KeyError for an unknown region propagates unchanged.
